description: This file contains a utility function 'formatStatusLabel' that converts deployment status codes into human-readable labels, primarily for display purposes in a UI. It replaces underscores/hyphens with spaces and converts strings to Title Case while handling edge cases like null, empty strings, and apostrophes.

methods.name: formatStatusLabel(value)
methods.description: Converts a raw status code string into a human-readable label by replacing delimiters with spaces and applying Title Case formatting, with fallback to 'Unknown' for null or empty inputs.
